CREATE TABLE gametabs_index (
  path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  game TEXT NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  page INTEGER NOT NULL,
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  slug_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  sitemap TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE gametabs_games (
  path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  game TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  tabs INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  read_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE gametabs_game_tabs (
  page TEXT NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  game TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  title_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  instruments TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  composers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  views INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  rating REAL,
  place INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (page, path)
)
CREATE TABLE kv (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE caracole_export (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
